injection_details.method: Classic remote DLL injection: OpenProcess -> VirtualAllocEx -> WriteProcessMemory -> CreateRemoteThread(LoadLibraryA, remote_path) -> WaitForSingleObject(INFINITE) -> CloseHandle
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS=0x2) + Process32First/Process32Next, strcmp() of PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile (dwSize=0x130, szExeFile at offset 0x2c) against the plaintext string "explorer.exe" (.rdata 0x1400040ac)
injection_details.payload_written: The XOR-decrypted DLL path string (strlen+1 bytes) is written into the remote process with WriteProcessMemory; the buffer is allocated with VirtualAllocEx(NULL, len+1, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE = 0x3000, PAGE_READWRITE = 0x4)
injection_details.remote_thread_start_routine: kernel32!LoadLibraryA, resolved via manual export-table parsing (manual_get_proc), parameter = remote buffer containing the DLL path
injection_details.api_resolution: GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll") (only IAT-visible call) then custom manual_get_proc() at 0x1400014ef which parses IMAGE_DOS_HEADER/IMAGE_NT_HEADERS, the export directory (DataDirectory[0] at NT+0x88), AddressOfNames / AddressOfNameOrdinals / AddressOfFunctions and strcmp's the exported names. Injection APIs (CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First/Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, WaitForSingleObject, CloseHandle, LoadLibraryA) are therefore absent from the import table.
injection_details.injection_function: inject_dll @ 0x14000167f, called from WinMain @ 0x140001ae9 only if anti_debug_check() returns 0

encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key XOR (byte-wise, key index = i % key_len), implemented in xor_decrypt() @ 0x140001480; called as xor_decrypt(stack_copy, len=0x20, g_xor_key, key_len=8) from WinMain @ 0x140001b56
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext array g_xor_key in .rdata at VA 0x140004000 (file offset 0x2800), immediately followed by the plaintext API/DLL name strings; ciphertext g_encrypted_dll_path is a 32-byte array in .data at VA 0x140003000 (file offset 0x2600) and is copied to the stack and decrypted in place at runtime (NUL appended at index 32)

anti_analysis: PEB BeingDebugged check without API calls: anti_debug_check() @ 0x14000163f reads the TEB at %gs:0x60 to obtain the PEB, then tests the byte at PEB+0x02 (BeingDebugged); on non-zero WinMain silently returns 0 and skips injection (no error output, evasive bail-out)
Dynamic API resolution via hand-written export-table parser (manual_get_proc) so injection APIs never appear in the import table / IAT (static-analysis and IAT-hook evasion)
XOR-obfuscated payload DLL path stored as a byte array in .data, decrypted only on the stack at runtime
Only benign-looking imports present (KERNEL32: GetModuleHandleA, Sleep, VirtualProtect/VirtualQuery, CRT helpers; msvcrt) - no networking, injection, or debugger-detection API imports
